integrity: Analytic proof based on exact weighted run generating functions, primitive finite-state transfers, strict spectral monotonicity, and a uniform shrinking-hole expansion; finite checks are corroborative.
scientific_limitations: IID two-hole choices only; periodic and dependent schedules are not optimized
Each fixed integer depth k is at least three; no arbitrary geometry generalization
Previously known averaged-transfer frameworks give general access to the spectral reduction; the substantive result is fair-bias optimality at every depth and its sharp limiting gain
Independent scientific validation and exhaustive literature priority review not performed
title: Fair switching maximizes annealed escape through complementary binary run holes
